issue_context.title: Incorrect minification of `(obj?.a).b`
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

As the title.

### Input code

```typescript
(obj?.a).b
```


### Config

```json
{
  "jsc": {
    "parser": {
      "syntax": "typescript",
      "tsx": true
    },
    "target": "es2022",
    "minify": {
      "compress": true,
      "mangle": true
    },
    "loose": false
  },
  "isModule": true,
  "minify": true
}
```


### Playground link (or link to the minimal reproduction)

https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.3.101-nightly-20231207.1&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA9PIT8qy10vU1EsCAAYRshYKAAAA&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAA22NPQ7DIAxG954Cec5QMfYOPQSiTkTEn2xHKopy9wJNUYds%2BD19j%2F2mFKxs4aH2%2BqxHNsRI466ESxTzrgSkZGRLLgtMPyvclNCGnRxfAWJoQWkjZH3X%2BhxAcNHN5T9vU8iEzGdlhIOJi8ertk%2BJm5iN52Y6B8fP9NrGorPxW28cHzjNEnLuAAAA

### SWC Info output

_No response_

### Expected behavior

```js
(obj?.a).b;
```

### Actual behavior

```js
obj?.a.b;
```

### Version

1.3.101-nightly-20231207.1

### Additional context

_No response_
